description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This pivotal leadership role offers an exciting opportunity to oversee all aspects of facility management, ensuring the highest standards of patient care, regulatory compliance, and operational efficiency. The successful candidate will be instrumental in fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff.As the LNHA, you will be responsible for strategic planning, financial oversight, and maintaining a culture of excellence. You will guide a compassionate team, ensuring the delivery of exceptional services while adhering to all state and federal guidelines. This is a chance to make a significant impact on the lives of residents and contribute to the continued success of a reputable facility.This full-time position offers a competitive salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000 per year, commensurate with experience and qualifications. Join a team committed to providing outstanding care and a supportive work environment.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland.
Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or a related field.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting.
Demonstrated knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care facilities.
Strong leadership, financial management, and interpersonal communication skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $115,000 to $145,000 per year, based on experience.

description:
Join a dedicated team at a premier healthcare facility in Alpine, AL, as a Full-time Registered Nurse (RN). This role offers a competitive hourly rate of $47/hr and the opportunity to make a significant impact on patient care. We are actively scheduling interviews, with availability Monday-Friday from 1 PM to 7 PM, and over the weekend as needed, demonstrating our commitment to finding the right candidate quickly.

As an RN, you will be responsible for providing high-quality nursing care, collaborating with a multidisciplinary team, and ensuring patient safety and well-being. This is an excellent opportunity for a compassionate and skilled nurse looking for a stable full-time position with a supportive environment.
requirements: Valid Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Alabama
Minimum of 1 year of experience as a Registered Nurse
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
